summary: Cognetti stated she 'vehemently supports Israel's right to defend itself' and would ensure Congress provides military aid to Israel.
quote: I vehemently support Israel's right to defend itself," she explained, "and would take extremely seriously Congress' role in ensuring they have the military aid that they need to defend themselves in a really dangerous neighborhood."

summary: FEC filings show Cognetti received $201,240 from pro-Israel PACs (chiefly J Street PAC $195K, DMFI PAC $3K, Democratic Jewish Outreach PA $3K) in 2026 cycle.
quote: Paige Cognetti has received $201,240 from pro-Israel PACs, had $382 spent supporting them in the 2026 cycle, chiefly from J Street PAC (FEC filings through 2026-10-19).
